note: Classified 2026-10-24: fabricated_stub_bug means one side is a real, sourced species and the other is a genus-name-collision stub (sourcedFrom:none, templated description, or bare unscoped checklistbank id) -- likely a bug, delete the fabricated side, do not allowlist. genuine_dual_source_or_true_homonym means both sides have real sourceIds -- some are true independent homonyms (allowlist-worthy), some look like GBIF-backbone double-counting of one organism (candidate for known-bad-gbif-backbone-placements.json instead) -- needs case-by-case review. 2026-10-24 cross-checked the genuine_dual_source_or_true_homonym bucket against IRMNG (checklistbank-2007, archive on disk, genus-level global homonym register): irmng_verdict is confirmed_true_homonym (18 genera, safe to allowlist), irmng_confirms_only_one_side (79 records across most genera -- the unconfirmed side is very likely the same organism misattributed to the wrong kingdom by some source, not independent homonymy -- needs a fix, not an allowlist entry), or irmng_does_not_confirm_either_side (1 record, Picomonas -- IRMNG itself is ambiguous/outdated here, needs manual research).
